name: Amal
overview: Amal is a male figure from the tribe of Asher, identified specifically as the son of Hotham. His mention in Scripture is brief, with no additional notes or detailed narrative about his life or deeds. His identity is primarily established through his paternal connection within the genealogical records.
namesAndTitles: The name Amal is a proper name meaning 'laborer' or 'troubler.' This meaning provides insight into the possible character or role associated with the name, though Scripture does not elaborate further on this aspect for Amal himself.
familyAndRelationships: Amal is explicitly recorded as the son of Hotham. Beyond this paternal relationship, Scripture does not provide further information about his family or other relationships.
scriptureSignificance: Amal's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Asher, helping to trace the lineage and heritage of this tribe. While not prominent for any particular event or role, his inclusion contributes to the biblical record of God's people and their families as preserved in 1 Chronicles.
